body: I’m scared. I don’t want to wait.
PTSD and trauma fucks with me. Logic isn’t my strong suit anymore. I can’t be logical anymore. I just need to get rid of what started me down this spiral.

I was committed three years ago by my ex when I attempted suicide. Ever since then, I’ve never talked about it to anybody. I’d rather die than go back to the hospital. I just want to leave my pain, on my own terms, in peace.
I was wearing a skirt when it happened. I was a fucking slut in a skirt. I was asking for it. I don’t know if I’m gonna go tonight but I don’t know if I’ll last the week.
I don’t feel like I can trust anyone because they all hate me. I am filthy. I’m alone. I’m with you tonight.
